feeds.title: Leeham News and Analysis
feeds.description: Leeham News and Analysis is an industry-leading commercial aviation news blog. Leeham News is the independent voice that cuts through the spin to deliver stories with verified facts, analysis and content that becomes a must-read every day. News and Comment principally focus on news, events, and analysis of issues involving Airbus.
